description: This file defines an interface 'WorkScheduleInterface' that specifies methods for handling work schedule details within the 'OrangeHRM' system, including shift times, non-working days, holidays, and employee number settings.

classes.name: WorkScheduleInterface
classes.description: Interface for defining methods related to work scheduling and shift information within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number, which can be null.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the work shift in hours as a float.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Returns the start and end times of the work shift as a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if the provided day is a non-working day, considering whether it is a full day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Determines if the provided day is a half-day.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if the provided day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if the provided day is a half-day holiday.
